Reference / random/distribution

random/distribution#

Stateful distribution views over an injected Randomizing capability.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let dice = UniformIntegers(random: random, start: 1, stop: 7);
let roll is int = dice.sample();

let noise = NormalDistribution(
    random: random,
    mean: 0.0,
    deviation: 1.0,
);
let value is float = noise.sample();

Description#

Stateful distribution views over an injected Randomizing capability. Calling sample() advances that source.

Integer and float uniforms are half-open. Samples chooses without replacement and rejects count outside 0..values.size(). Choices and weighted choices require non-empty values. Weights must be non-negative, have the same size as values, and contain at least one positive value. The current immutable linked-list removal used by Samples costs O(n*count); it can later be replaced by a persistent indexed collection without changing this public contract.

Continuous algorithms are fixed for seeded reproducibility: Box-Muller for normal values, Marsaglia-Tsang for gamma, two independent gamma samples for beta, and Best-Fisher rejection for von Mises. Degenerate normal and log-normal distributions with zero deviation consume no random values.
